summary: BrainsWay Ltd. filed Form 6-K with a press release announcing peer-reviewed study results showing a 70% relative reduction in suicidal ideation among MDD patients treated with Deep TMS. The filing includes clinical data from a secondary analysis, with no corporate transaction, board action, or special-situation event. It is a routine disclosure of clinical trial findings, not a special situation. The registrant acts solely as the filer reporting operational and scientific progress. No deal terms or strategic corporate actions are involved. Watch for future regulatory or commercial developments but no special-situation angle applies.
